name: Westfield Culver City
description: Westfield Culver City is a premier shopping destination in West Los Angeles featuring major department stores like Macy's, JCPenney, and Target alongside popular retailers including Sephora, H&M, UNIQLO, and Best Buy. The multi-level enclosed mall offers diverse dining options from BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse to specialty eateries on the dining terrace, plus unique entertainment with Activate, the world's first active gaming facility. With convenient amenities including free Wi-Fi, EV charging stations, and locker services, this Westfield property serves as a comprehensive retail and entertainment hub for the Culver City community.
demographics: Affluent West Los Angeles residents, entertainment industry professionals, tourists visiting nearby studios and attractions, diverse demographic mix from surrounding communities
summary: A dynamic multi-level Westfield mall in Culver City featuring major anchors, popular brands, diverse dining, and innovative entertainment experiences in the heart of West LA.
